Thank you for providing the photos. After analyzing them, it appears that there is a scratch on the surface caused by an external substance. Hello Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0378622 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
DE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Please conduct a site intervention to inspect the primary FAN located at the top of GQ1. Upon review of the video, it appears that there may be some wires causing obstruction while the FAN is operational. Kindly examine all the wires within the top compartment of the charger, particularly focusing on the sensing unit wires as they could potentially be the source of the issue.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
DE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
